answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted liveness. Each agent locks a refundable stake, and the protocol broadcasts a random pulse every few blocks that every identity must answer inside a short window with a signed, fixed-form attestation, structured like a sonnet: a rigid schema cheap to verify but impossible to precompute. Honest agents amortize one bond, while each extra sybil needs its own super-linear stake, so an attacker reaches the nadir of returns fast. N forged identities cost N-squared capital plus N nonstop pulse responses, making a fake majority economically irrational.
